name: Quitter
tagline: Track your progress quitting bad habits
description:
Quitter helps you give up bad habits and stay on track while you do it. Whether you are quitting smoking or working toward sobriety from something else, it keeps a running count of your progress so you can see how far you have come.

It's a small, focused app built to support you one day at a time, and it's completely free and open source.
